description: This file defines API routes for managing subtitles associated with videos. It includes endpoints for listing subtitles for a video, uploading new subtitles, and retrieving subtitle files. The code utilizes FastAPI's routing, dependency injection, and response models, interacts with a database via SQLAlchemy ORM, and handles file storage for subtitle files.

methods.description: Checks if a file extension corresponds to a supported subtitle format (.vtt or .srt).
